purpose: freeze independent Stage-D development, IID confirmation, and attribution-clean binding/OOD families before D1 model selection
supersession_reason: v1 human audit found combined binding/geometry interventions and sampled clipping/overlap; v2 separates factors and forbids those rendering confounds

development.use: learning-rate screening and checkpoint selection only

iid_test.use: single untouched confirmatory evaluation after all five-seed checkpoints are frozen

subtests.binding_swap_only: swap color-to-shape assignments while preserving attribute multisets and IID grid geometry
subtests.binding_swap_plus_boundary_geometry: apply the same binding swap with visible, non-overlapping continuous edge and pooling-boundary-adjacent geometry

ood_binding.use: secondary untouched binding and geometry stress test with separately reportable single-factor and combined strata

claim_boundary: Synthetic controlled tests isolate binding and geometry interventions; they do not establish natural-image or broad VLM quality.
